text.en: This Order may be cited as the Employment (Amendment) Order, 2015. Amendment of section 103 of S 3712009

Section 103 of the Employment Order, 2009 is amended -

(a) in subsection (I), by deleting "subsections (2) and" from the last line and "subsection" therefor;

(b) by deleting subsection (2). Made this 7th. day of Muharram, 1437 Hijriah corresponding to the 20th. day of October, 2015 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam. THE'SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
